rule.description: AI chat assistant installed: $(program.name) $(program.version) by $(program.vendor) at $(program.location)
rule.info: Detects installation of common AI chat assistant clients from Wazuh Syscollector software inventory.
Falsepositives: Product names can overlap with unrelated software. Validate vendor and installation path before policy enforcement.

rule.description: AI coding tool installed: $(program.name) $(program.version) by $(program.vendor) at $(program.location)
rule.info: Detects installation of AI coding assistants or AI-focused development tools from Wazuh Syscollector software inventory.
Falsepositives: Some names, such as Cursor or Cody, may appear in unrelated software. Validate vendor and installation path.

rule.description: Local AI/LLM runtime installed: $(program.name) $(program.version) by $(program.vendor) at $(program.location)
rule.info: Detects local LLM runtimes, local AI workbenches, or self-hosted AI frontends from Wazuh Syscollector software inventory.
Falsepositives: Portable or source-based tools may not appear in installed software inventory. Add process or FIM rules if needed.

rule.description: AI image/media tool installed: $(program.name) $(program.version) by $(program.vendor) at $(program.location)
rule.info: Detects installation of AI image, media, or local generative AI tools from Wazuh Syscollector software inventory.
Falsepositives: Some tools are portable Git/Python projects and may not be visible as installed packages.
